core_obligations: (gamma) iff (alpha)+(beta) is immediate from the definition of (gamma).
The four diamond edges (theta, iota, eta into zeta) are single definition-containment checks.
(epsilon) implies (delta): W affine open of U_i; W x_X U_i = W x_{X_i} U_i is quasi-compact; the locally quasi-finite boundedness lemma bounds p; descend to W -> X by the descent lemma.
(delta) implies (gamma): base change bounds R -> U; composition bounds R -> X; the finiteness lemma gives finite fibres over every x.
